effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may use 1 [Onmyōjutsu] or [Plug-In] Option card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When you use Option cards, you may play 1 [Pipe Fox] Token. (Digimon/Yellow/6000 DP/＜Blocker＞)
